fullDescription: A high-density, professional B2B dashboard for enterprise-grade project planning and portfolio management. Characterized by a deep navy dark mode aesthetic (#0b1530), it utilizes a 'native macOS app' feel with traffic-light window controls and a sidebar navigation. The typography pairs Plus Jakarta Sans for headers, Inter for body text, and JetBrains Mono for numeric data. This design is optimized for sectors like real estate development, fintech, logistics, and SaaS infrastructure where information density and precision are prioritized over white space. It features blueprint-style thumbnails, data-heavy tables, and subtle sparklines for performance tracking.

structured.summary: Atria is a high-density project management dashboard designed for serious professional use. It features a deep navy palette, a native desktop application aesthetic, and a rigorous table-first approach to data visualization. It avoids marketing fluff (no emojis or welcome messages) in favor of precision, utility, and information-rich components like status pills and inline sparklines.

style.description: The style is a sophisticated dark-mode UI with a 'native app' signature. It uses a deep navy background (#0b1530) and a slightly lighter surface for the main content area (#0f1a3a). Typography is highly structured: Plus Jakarta Sans for UI headings (13-14px), Inter for body and labels (11-12px), and JetBrains Mono for IDs and numeric metrics. Colors are used semantically for status states: Amber (#fbbf24) for Entitlement, Cyan (#22d3ee) for Design, Purple (#a855f7) for Permitting, and Emerald (#10b981) for Construction. Borders are extremely subtle, using a 6% opacity white (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)).
style.prompt:
Create a high-density, dark-mode professional dashboard. 
- **Color Palette**: Sidebar background: #0b1530; Main content background: #0f1a3a; Primary accent: Amber #fbbf24; Secondary accent: Cyan #22d3ee; Border color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06).
- **Typography**: Headers: Plus Jakarta Sans (Semi-bold); Body: Inter (Regular/Medium); Data/Monospaced: JetBrains Mono. Font sizes range from 10px (labels) to 20px (large metrics).
- **Atmosphere**: Professional, institutional, and precise. No large shadows, no soft gradients, no emojis. 
- **Borders/Corners**: Use 1px borders with low opacity. Component radius should be 4px to 8px. 
- **Native Feel**: Include macOS-style traffic light dots (Red #ff5f56, Yellow #ffbd2e, Green #27c93f) in the top-left corner of the sidebar.

layout_and_structure.description: A classic two-column dashboard layout with a fixed sidebar (240px) and a fluid main content area. The main content is structured vertically: Top navigation bar, 4-column metric grid, filter/control bar, and a hero data table.

prompts.prompt: Width: 240px. Background: #0b1530. Top section: macOS traffic lights followed by a workspace switcher (32x32 rounded icon, bold label, chevron). Nav items: Vertical list with 12px spacing, using icons (lucide-style) and labels in Inter 14px. Active state: bg-white/10 and amber icon. Footer: User profile section with 32px avatar, name, role, and a status presence dot.

Height: 56px. Layout: Breadcrumb navigation on the left (e.g., Workspace / Projects) in low-contrast white. Right side: A search bar (280px wide) with a built-in '⌘K' shortcut badge in mono font, and a primary 'New Project' button in Amber #fbbf24 with dark text.

Four equal-width cards. Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03). Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Each card contains: Top-aligned label in all-caps 10px bold text (40% opacity), a large numeric value in JetBrains Mono, and a small 16x60px sparkline SVG showing a performance trend.

Horizontal layout. Left: A series of filter chips (Status, Type, Region, Owner) with 11px font and 1px borders. Right: A segmented view-toggle (Table, Board, Map icons) using a ghost-button style with active state highlighting.

The hero component. Headers: All-caps, 10px, bold, tracking-widest, 30% opacity. Rows: 40px height, subtle bottom border. Features: Blueprint-style site thumbnails (32x32) with radial grid backgrounds; Status pills with 6px leading dots; Owner avatars (24px); Schedule health indicators (colored dot + text); 'Updated' column in 30% opacity text. On hover, the row should show an 'options' menu button at the far right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Dimensions: 32x32px. Background: #0f1a3a with a subtle 8px radial dot grid (blueprint style). Border: 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Content: Minimalist white-line SVG outline of a site plan or building footprint (stroke-width: 1px, opacity: 0.2).

special_ui_components.description: Contextual status badges with semantic coloring.
special_ui_components.prompt: Height: 20px. Padding: 2px 8px. Corner radius: 4px. Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04). Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Content: A 6px solid circular dot followed by 11px medium weight Inter text. Dot colors: Amber #fbbf24, Cyan #22d3ee, Purple #a855f7, Emerald #10b981, Rose #f43f5e, Slate #64748b.

special_ui_components.description: Minimalist trend indicator within metric cards.
special_ui_components.prompt: Width: 64px. Height: 24px. Path: Single stroke, 2px thickness. No fill. Colors should match the metric's health (e.g., Amber for currency, Emerald for schedule gains, Rose for pending). Smooth cubic-bezier curves for the path.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain high information density (at least 8-10 rows visible). MUST: Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric IDs and financial values. MUST: Keep status pills to a 4px corner radius. DO NOT: Use standard card grids for projects. DO NOT: Use high-contrast borders or drop shadows. DO NOT: Include a 'Welcome' or 'Hello' header.
